=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Nick: Hi Phong! Who is your best friend in class 6A?
Phong: Hello Nick! My best friend is Minh. He sits next to me in class.
Nick: What does he look like?
Phong: He is tall with short black hair and big brown eyes. He always has a cheerful smile.
Nick: What is he like?
Phong: He is very clever, sporty, and kind. He often helps me with difficult math homework.
Nick: What sports do you two play together?
Phong: We play football every Wednesday afternoon and cycle in the park on weekends.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Lan is my close friend at secondary school. She is twelve years old and has long black hair. Lan is an active and creative girl who loves drawing and reading comic books. She is also very caring and shares her snacks with classmates. Everyone in class likes Lan because she is always friendly and polite.

602.readingText: An Giang Secondary School is a famous boarding school located in the Mekong Delta region. More than five hundred students from nearby villages study and live here during the weekdays. The school has modern facilities, including twenty large classrooms, three computer rooms, and a well-equipped science laboratory.
